mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyperglycemia, while budesonide (systemic/oral formulation) can potentiate these effects through mineralocorticoid activity and glucocorticoid-induced metabolic changes.
action: Monitor serum potassium and glucose levels regularly; consider potassium supplementation or potassium-sparing agent; use lowest effective budesonide dose; counsel on dietary potassium intake.
